fixes.rationale_full: Test-only fix for REL-PROXY-001 AC-3. (1) Unit level: driveRelayedEnd now asserts, in the CLOSE_AFTER_ABORT ordering right after abortListener.run() and BEFORE relayed.close(), that the counter is 0, the watchdog reservation was cancelled once and the backend observed its connection closed (assertAbortAloneEndedTheExchange). A new EndOrder ABORT_ALONE and test rel_PROXY_001_AC3_theAbortNotificationAloneEndsTheExchange runs only the abort notification (no close at all) and checks the same, plus the existing post-conditions. Because the relayed stream is never closed before these assertions, a closed backend socket can only come from the proxy's own release. (2) Real path: rel_PROXY_001_AC3_anAbortDuringABlockedRelayCopyClosesTheBackend mounts the proxy (.maxConcurrent(1), recording watchdog) on the in-memory adapter against HoldingBackend HEAD_THEN_HOLD (Content-Length 10, 2 body bytes, then silence), waits by stack inspection until a thread is in DefaultResponse.runTransfer inside a socket read (the copy is running, so core abort leaves the input open), then calls res.abort(null) and asserts counter 0 and one reservation cancel immediately, and that the backend observes the close within 3 s. No fixed sleeps are used as correctness proof; waits are latches and bounded polls. Adapted from the reviewer repro ReviewReproAbortClosesBackendTest. Production code unchanged.
